**CORRECTED AGAIN 2026-08-29 — this task's title and table describe a root that is already dead.**

daemonkit cut **v0.23.0** on 2026-08-26, moving the state root a *second* time: `~/.daemonkit/agents/<label>` → **`~/.daemonkit/a/<label>`**. Commit `cddc572` names the reason — v0.22.0's root spent 18 of the 103 bytes darwin's `sun_path` leaves for a socket path, and cc-orchestrate's pty daemons came out at exactly 104 under a long account name. Their label already carries 64 bits of a nonce hash and nothing else, so the byte came out of the root: `agents` became `a`, and that path measures 99. Same contract as v0.22.0 — no migration, no fallback read, old state deleted by hand once every consumer has repinned.

So there are now **two** dead generations to wipe on each host, not one: `~/<label>/` and `~/.daemonkit/agents/<label>/`.

**The consumer count was 13; the real number is 14.** `cc-skills` — module `github.com/yasyf/cc-skills/plugins/codex`, shipping the `codex-ask` cask — is a genuine consumer that is **absent from `fleet-build.yml`'s matrix and from `ci/fleet-refs.txt`**. It is the one consumer that missed *both* root moves, and it sat at daemonkit v0.21.4 while all 13 others moved. The cause is structural, not an oversight: `scripts/fleet-build.sh` hardcodes `"$1/go.mod"` (`:139,:154,:158,:159,:182,:238,:247`) and resolves a checkout by module *basename* (`checkout_of`, `:165-169`), so it cannot build a repo whose module lives at `plugins/codex/`. The gate could not have caught this. See the note "A daemonkit consumer migrates when it SHIPS, not when its main is bumped".

**Authoritative state as of 2026-08-29:**

| State | Consumers |
|---|---|
| Released **with** v0.23.0 | cc-notes 0.51.2, synckit 0.38.0, captain-hook 12.22.4, cc-review 0.35.0, **cc-patch 0.16.0** (tagged 2026-08-29), fusekit 1.19.0, cc-pool 0.68.0 |
| Bumped on `main`, never released | cc-orchestrate, cc-present, reposync, cookiesync, binrun, cc-interact |
| **No bump at all** | cc-skills (`plugins/codex`, v0.21.4) |

`cc-interact` needs no release for this migration: it is a library with no launchd daemon (its only label literal is in `examples/echo/main.go`), and Go MVS gives its consumers v0.23.0 through their own `go.mod` regardless.

**Host state 2026-08-29.** This workstation: 10 `~/com.*`, 4 `~/.daemonkit/agents/`, **0** `~/.daemonkit/a/`. `yasyf-forge-studio`: 0, 0, **7** — already fully migrated. The divergence is not a bug; see the migrates-on-release note.

Closing this task now requires: cc-skills bumped and released; the fleet-build gate taught about module subdirectories so cc-skills becomes a leg; the 5 unreleased daemon owners tagged; both dead generations wiped on both hosts.
